description.en: A striking East Asian perching duck celebrated in art and culture for the breathtakingly colorful plumage of the male.
description.zh: 一种原产于东亚的林栖鸭类，因雄鸟极其绚丽夺目的羽毛而在文化与艺术中备受赞誉。

anatomy.en: The male boasts a stunning array of colors, characterized by an iridescent purple breast, distinctive orange 'sails' on the back, and striking facial markings. The female is significantly more cryptic, adorned in mottled grey-brown hues with a distinct white eye-ring.
anatomy.zh: 雄鸟拥有一身令人惊叹的艳丽色彩，特征是闪烁的紫色胸部、背部独特的橙色“帆状羽”以及醒目的面部斑纹。而雌鸟则低调得多，身披灰褐色的斑驳羽毛，并带有一个明显的白色眼圈。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Unlike typical ducks, they are highly adapted to arboreal life, nesting in tree cavities close to lakes and swiftly taking flight maneuver through densely wooded areas. Newly hatched ducklings perform a daring leap to the ground from their high nests shortly after birth.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 与典型的鸭类不同，它们高度适应树栖生活，通常在靠近湖泊的树洞中筑巢，并能在茂密的林地中轻巧地穿梭飞行。刚孵化的雏鸟在出生后不久就要从高高的巢穴中进行勇敢的“信仰之跃”下落到地面。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Native to forested wetland habitats in East Asia, encompassing eastern Russia, China, and Japan. Healthy introduced populations have also established themselves in parks across Europe, particularly Great Britain.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 原产于东亚的森林湿地和水域，包括俄罗斯东部、中国和日本。此外，有些健康的引入种群也成功地在欧洲（特别是英国）的公园中扎根繁衍。
